real_chapter_comparisons: All successful old-engine cases match glyph/line counts, geometry/paint, effective text colors and source correspondence. Old paint updates panic in c1/c3; candidate matches independent full-cascade layout instead.
intentional_correctness_change: First-line shaping reuses the normalized first-letter selection. The old path reinterpreted renderer glyph cache IDs as codepoints, selecting punctuation and expanded letters incorrectly. A dedicated test checks opening punctuation and the full uppercase expansion of ß.
scope: Real c1/c2/c3 HTML, CSS and provider resources; deterministic mock font backend. Native font shaping, GPU work, image decoding and full application latency are outside this harness.

method.instructions: Linux perf user-mode retired instructions, gated to measured operation, scaled for multiplexing
method.memory: Separate allocator-instrumented process records live and peak requested heap; uninstrumented process getrusage records peak RSS. Decimal MB.

timing_limitation: Other tasks ran on this shared machine. Large wall-time/CPU-time gaps and per-round drift show scheduler contention and clock/cache variation. Timings are observed values; instruction counts give the more stable CPU-work comparison. The final run began after this task finished compiling.
tradeoffs: The retained generalized decoration program reduces paint work and retained heap, with about 0.4-1.0% extra instructions for font/resize/handoff cases across these chapters. Palette updates cover specialized layouts without relayout.
baseline_exceptions: Preexisting style-model size/niche assertion filtered out
External WPT integration requires unavailable HTML_WPT_ROOT
